title: One-Dish Mexican Chicken & Rice Bake
description: Raw rice, chicken thigh, kidney beans, tomatoes and capsicum baked together in stock, finished with melted cheddar.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 244, rated 9.25/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @adamhoad_coaching.

confidence.note: Amounts from the creator's caption. The caption lists the diced tomatoes but its method omits them; adding them in step 2 is inferred. Spice amounts are to taste. Not yet cooked.

items.note: Raw; the source just says rice

items.item: salt, pepper, paprika and ground cumin

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Combine the rice ({{rice}}), tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), kidney beans ({{beans}}), onion ({{onion}}), capsicum ({{capsicum}}), chicken ({{chicken}}), stock ({{stock}}) and spices in a large ovenproof dish and mix well.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 45 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.

steps.title: Cheese
steps.text: Scatter over the cheddar ({{cheddar}}) and let it melt before serving.

notes.title: Covering
notes.text: The source does not say whether the dish is covered. Check the rice at 45 minutes.
